Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity mobile game production design, ONE full-screen portrait image per request, 1080 x 2340 (390 x 844 CSS-pixel layout). Straight-on edge-to-edge game UI, no phone bezel, no poster border, no external annotations. Input reference: the supplied image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an existing playable implementation. Preserve its premium floating sky-palace world: ivory carved stone, polished champagne gold, emerald glass roofs, blue sky, rich foliage, lush miniature 3D buildings with baked ambient occlusion. This is a real-time troop strategy game called exactly “连线占塔”. Improve practical hierarchy over the reference: the title is modest, only 22 CSS px; sky scenery is atmospheric background; the usable battlefield is large and readable. Render clean legible Chinese sans-serif UI labels with crisp high-contrast numbers. Every tower has a LARGE garrison troop number in a solid dark badge, a smaller separate “Lv.1” or “Lv.2” label, and a team-shaped pennant. These tower numbers are SOLDIERS, not points. Score is labelled “积分” only in the top player cards. Make actual marching soldiers unmistakably visible on roads: little gold helmets, ivory armor, team-colored cloaks, shields, tiny shadows, naturally spaced groups following the curved paths. Some squads visibly fight with tiny sword-impact sparks at an enemy gate. No gore. Make roads distinct from decorative terrain. No unreadable tiny labels, no neon web of crossing lines, no watermark or third-party company logo. Minimal strong local effects, no global bloom washing out values. Team identity uses BOTH colors and symbols: emerald diamond, coral triangle, sapphire circle, violet square. Towers, readable counters and soldiers have visual priority over foliage and gold ornament. Total layout respects top/bottom safe areas and comfortably sized hit targets. It must look exceptionally beautiful and credible as a premium published mobile strategy game.
Screen 1: TWO-PLAYER ACTIVE BATTLE. Top 16%: a compact header with back control, centered “连线占塔”, sound and help controls; under it two symmetrical player cards “你 · 积分 120” and “对手 · 积分 96”, central dark clock “02:18”. Show a discreet objective chip “占领王城，持续得分”. Main central 66%: a broad, steep-view isometric floating island with ELEVEN distinct large castle towers and clear connected stone roads. Arrange 6 outer and 4 inner towers plus central crown citadel, spaced so every tower can be tapped independently. Emerald belongs to YOU, coral to OPPONENT, neutral towers have ivory roofs and gray shield emblems. Central neutral crown citadel has garrison badge “30”, separate “王城” marker, and a thin gold ring; it is valuable but not already captured. Emerald lower-left frontline barracks is SELECTED with a clear emerald ring, troop badge “36”, “Lv.1” and diamond banner; a second emerald tower is “24” “Lv.2”. Other troop numbers such as 12, 18, 22, 28 should be cleanly readable. Show TWO emerald squads of 5–7 visible soldiers marching from lower-left toward a central neighbor, and a coral squad of 5 visible soldiers moving from upper-right toward a contested tower; one tiny localized gate battle and a red “−4” feedback. Draw subtle glowing directional segments underneath marching troops, not instead of troops. No arrows obscure soldiers. Bottom 18%: integrated elegant ivory-and-gold command panel. First row selected-tower thumbnail and exact “兵营  Lv.1”, a soldier icon with “驻兵 36 / 40”, and small “产兵 1 / 秒”. Second row a clearly labelled send selector “派兵比例” with two real touch buttons “50%” (selected emerald) and “全部” (unselected ivory); alongside a prominent emerald button with upward chevron “升级 · 20兵”. Bottom one-line instruction “拖到敌塔进攻，拖到己塔增援”. Give button faces convincing raised materials and pressed/unpressed state. No decorative fake menu buttons, no unrelated currency, no spin, no battle pass, no bottom app navbar. The island must remain fully visible above the command panel. Keep castle bases and numbers separated without overlapping labels.

Footer hint exactly “拖动派兵 · 点击城堡查看详情”. Do not cram extra buildings or more than thirteen towers. No modal and no economy menus. Strong visual quality and clarity at phone scale is paramount.
